text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['swin'] == 0) & (df['dwin'] == 0) & (df['stcpb'] == 0) & (df['dtcpb'] == 0) & (df['tcprtt'] == 0) & (df['synack'] == 0) & (df['ackdat'] == 0))"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP window, sequence-number, and connection-setup timing features are unavailable for non-TCP flows and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'http') | ((df['trans_depth'] == 0) & (df['response_body_len'] == 0) & (df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] == 0))"],"features":["service","trans_depth","response_body_len","ct_flw_http_mthd"],"rationale":"HTTP transaction depth, HTTP response-body length, and HTTP-method flow counts are zero when the flow is not classified as HTTP."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'ftp') | ((df['is_ftp_login'] == 0) & (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0))"],"features":["service","is_ftp_login","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"FTP login and command features are zero for flows not classified as FTP."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(~df['service'].isin(['http', 'ftp', 'ftp-data', 'smtp', 'ssh', 'irc'])) | (df['proto'] == 'tcp')"],"features":["service","proto"],"rationale":"The listed application services use TCP as their transport protocol."}]}
